import unittest
from access import delete_record

class AccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_matching_admin(self):
        records = [{"tenant": "one"}]
        self.assertEqual({"tenant": "one"}, delete_record(records, 0, "admin", "one"))
        self.assertEqual([], records)
